name: worklogs
description: Journal de travail local : écrire, mettre en page, organiser — sur un seul écran.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix api install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix api run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.start: npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix api start
scripts.test: npm --prefix api test && npm --prefix web test
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run build && npm run desktop:stage && electron-builder --linux --x64 --dir --publish never
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build && npm run desktop:stage && electron-builder --linux --x64 --publish never
